node_start.source: steps cycles before a first unit word lands

node_floor.source: steps of a kernel with no work, beside the units

node_image.source: node cycles a program word sent to its core, once a launch

node_wait.source: node cycles a wait on a unit, once the unit is done

mover_statement.source: mover cycles between two copies of a move

mover_fill.source: mover cycles between two fills of a move

mover_element.source: mover cycles an indexed element beyond its words: one strided side on the card

vc_fe_sync.source: core cycles a front end waits on math beyond its timing

vc_pack_op.source: core cycles an f16 pack beyond its timing

vc_unpack_op.source: core cycles an unpack beyond its timing

vc_fill_trim.source: cycles the machine's fill latency reads over a fill: Verilator's idle memory, the card's cold DRAM

vc_memory_word.source: the machine's cycles a fill or drain word scale, 2 to 3 on cold DRAM: 11.7 B a cycle written

mover_run.source: mover cycles a contiguous run: a cold run is a DRAM row on each side

mover_word.source: mover cycles a 32-byte word: 10.8 B a cycle past the Xache, 1.58 cycles inside it

read_bus.source: bytes a node cycle the shared read return carries

write_bus.source: bytes a node cycle of drains

mg_fill_entry.source: node cycles a 128-byte entry, one cluster alone

mg_start.source: node cycles a GEMM's sweep starts after its issue

mg_sweep.source: node cycles a GM x GN x NK unit

mg_drain_word.source: node cycles a sub-tile, one cluster alone

launch_front.source: head, copy, bind and barrier of a run

launch_gap.source: idle cycles before a run's head
